name: caygnus-incident-feed
description: Caygnus Product Engineering Challenge - Reconnecting Real-Time Feed

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
